test_title: PYST 41: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 01 Sept, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

A + B means ‘A is the husband of B’,

A – B means ‘A is the mother of B’,

A x B means ‘A is the daughter of B’ and

A ÷ B means ‘A is the brother of B’.

How is G related to P if ‘G ÷ I x L + N – P’?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Husband
 Mother
 Daughter
 Brother
 
 

 

Given: G ÷ I x L + N – P

It means:

G is the Brother of I.

I is the Daughter of L.

Lis the Husband of N.

N is the Mother of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eec5577cd0061623c0313ec7a7447511d1d2ac638eb23e344fc3e355a9070d61.png] 

So, G is the 'Brother' of P.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
